senses.gloss: खः + -चर a. flying, moving in the air.

खः + -चर + ({@-रः@}) or {@खेचरः@}
—1 a bird.
—2 a cloud.
—3 the sun.
—4 the wind.
—5 a demon.
—6 an aerial spirit.
—7 a Gandharva or Vidyādhara खचरनगरकल्पं कल्पितं शास्त्रदृष्टया
 Mb. 7. 7. 54; दिव्यस्रग्वस्त्रसन्नाहाः कलत्रैः खेचरा इव Bhāg. 10. 82. 9.
—8 a planet. (hence the number ‘nine’).
—9 mercury or quicksilver.
—10 a sign of the zodiac.

खः + -चर + ({@-री@} i. e. {@खेचरी@})
—1 a semi-divine female able to fly.
—2 an epithet of Durgā.
—3 The
[]
 magical power of flying (सिद्धि); एवं सखीभिरुक्ताहं खेचरीसिद्धिलोलुभा Ks. 20. 105.
—4 a particular मुद्रा or position of fingers.
खः + -चारिन् a. moving in the air. ━(m.) an epithet of Skanda.

खच् I. €1. €9 P. (खचति, खच्नाति, खचित)
—1 To come forth, appear.
—2 To be born again.
—3 To purify. ━II. €10 U. (खचयति, खचित)
—1 To fasten, bind.
—2 To set, inlay.

खचित p. p. [खच्-क्त]
—1 Fastened, joined, full of, intermixed with; शकुन्तनीडखचितं बिभ्रज्जटामण्डलम्
 Ś. 7. 11 (v. l.).
—2 Mixed, blended.
—3 Inlaid, set, studded; in comp. मणि˚, रत्न˚ Māl. 8. 10.
—4 Made of worsted varieties of thread by sewing; Kau. A. 2. 11.
